matching.metric: Signed alpha-weighted mean OkLab chroma change over all visible input pixels; neutral and low-chroma pixels remain included.
matching.rule: Same nonzero sign, minimum absolute target, error <= max(absolute tolerance, relative tolerance * abs(target)). Freeze tuning per scene/direction/output policy; acceptance is a distinct spatial permutation with identical color distribution. No acceptance refit.

primary.rule: Separate saturation and vibrance. Equal-weight mean of four scenes and +/-20. Each informative mean (baseline > floor) must improve by >=10%; otherwise candidate must stay <= floor. At least one informative target must improve. All rows must match and retain complete input-defined hue support for both outputs.
primary.target: Hue and lightness drift measured against original input, not against Glowroom output. Compatibility is diagnostic only.

criticalRationale: Conservative predeclared engineering guards, not perceptual thresholds. Hue/gamut/clipping/alpha reuse LC01 scale; mean absolute OkLab-L and gradation limits are independent new guards. Only matched mapped candidates can veto their own control; unbounded output is a diagnostic ablation. Full saturation -100 has no meaningful hue target and is governed by an independent achromatic contract.

contracts.zeroIdentity: Both controls zero must preserve the canonical input raster hash exactly, including extended RGB; output gamut mapping is bypassed.
contracts.numeric: All outputs finite; alpha preserved; hidden RGB canonical zero; signed cube roots and no implicit RGB clipping before the explicit mapped output policy.
contracts.fullDesaturation: Independent of matching: saturation=-100, vibrance=0 must produce achromatic output within numeric tolerance; source matrices need not produce bit-identical channels.

outputPolicies.gamutMappedSRGB: Pinned ColorOps saturation/vibrance subset, then Rec2020 to extended-linear sRGB and original gamut_map_to with luma [.2126,.7152,.0722], peak1. No tone/profile/mixer/grading.
outputPolicies.unbounded: Same ColorOps subset without output gamut mapping; preserve signed and >1 values. Diagnostic only; its gamut behavior must not decide the mapped candidate.

requiredMissingUntilMeasured: Licensed real-photo portraits across skin tones, natural textiles/flowers and saturated P3 photographs
Production process/version, cache, rapid slider/image changes, cancellation, undo and preview/export integration
Accelerated path parity if a CI/Metal integration is proposed
decisionOrder: Verified independent contract regression, matched critical/performance regression or complete matched primary target failure gives no-go for that control.
Missing matching or visual/real/integration evidence gives blocked, never go. No pooling of output-policy ablations.
Adopt only proven better control subset after Go and LC02.
